Product.ctaNote: No credit card required • Set up in 2 min
Product.aiProfilesDesc: Forget keyword search that eliminates good profiles. Our AI analyzes semantics, career path, and potential. It reads the CV like a human expert would, but in a fraction of a second.
Product.candidateCardQuote: Relevant profile. Validated technical skills. Management experience aligned with the need.
Product.diffuseDesc: Connect Seeklon to LinkedIn, Indeed, Monster and your social networks. Publish your job from our interface and let the magic happen. All applications funnel into one pipeline.
Product.interviewDesc: AI doesn't stop at sorting. For each selected candidate, Seeklon generates a custom interview guide with questions to ask and points to delve into, based on CV and job offer analysis.
Product.interviewSuggestedQuestion: Can you detail your experience on project X mentioned in your CV?

hero.body: No HR team required. That conviction is what gave birth to Seeklon.

items.title: Why
items.body: Hiring well should not be reserved for companies with an HR team. Every company should be able to understand and improve its hiring decisions.

items.title: How
items.body: Explainable AI, interview guides and data analysis. The first screening gets simpler, the decision stays with the recruiter.

items.title: What
items.body: A steering and decision-support platform that connects application analysis, interview preparation and a clear view of the process.

vision.label: Our vision
vision.quote: Hire with method, learn from your decisions, and lean on technology without handing it your choices.

hackathon.caption: Bpifrance hackathon, on AI and ethics
hackathon.body: Seeklon was born during the Bpifrance hackathon devoted to AI and ethics. Bpifrance created the Jury’s Favourite award especially for our project.
hackathon.after: Since then, we have been turning it into a real product, and making it grow.

closing.body: Seeklon prepares everything useful for your hiring. The decision stays in your hands.
closing.note: Free throughout the beta, no commitment.
